content.summary: This page is a list of literature references (352–362) focused largely on natriuretic peptide–guided treatment and prognostic implications in heart failure, and on telemonitoring/telemedicine approaches (including systematic reviews and position papers) for management of patients with chronic heart failure.
notable_items: Reference 352: effect of B-type natriuretic peptide-guided treatment of chronic heart failure on mortality and hospitalization (individual patient meta-analysis).
Reference 353: changes in brain natriuretic peptide over time and mortality/morbidity in the Valsartan Heart Failure Trial (Val-HeFT).
Reference 354: prognostic implications of changes in N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide in patients with heart failure.
Multiple references (355–362) addressing telemonitoring, remote management, and digital health implementation in heart failure care.

genes.context: References 352–354 explicitly mention B-type (brain) natriuretic peptide and N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide in the context of BNP-guided treatment, changes over time in heart failure trials, and prognostic implications for patients with heart failure.
